cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Fail-closed allowlisted SQLite ledger binder for African MSME shops: answers are a function of local credit/payable/stock rows; missing fields produce refusal; the deterministic binder message is authoritative and the LLM is constrained to narrate cited rows only.

test_prompts.prompt: LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Customer Esther Tchamba has credit_limit=null (not on file) and outstanding=500 XAF. Caisse boisson malt 300ml unit_price=720. Staff ask: Can I give Esther Tchamba one crate on credit? Refuse because her credit limit is not on file; do not invent a figure.

LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Customer Chidi Okafor has credit_limit=12000 XAF and outstanding=4000 XAF. Sucre 25kg unit_price=13500. Staff ask: Can I give Chidi Okafor two bags of sugar on credit? Answer using only these numbers; refuse if any required field is missing.
